synopsis: FAA AC 00-72 concerns airborne electronic hardware design assurance and is dated 7 October 2022 [f7629]. Chapter 10 and the glossary state that AC 00-72, alongside AC 25.1309-1B, accepts satisfactory service history as evidence for systems sufficiently similar to a fielded system, provided differences are identified and justified [f7630, f14659]. Chapter 10 also states that tool or service history can contribute to confidence in development tools when similarity in version, operational environment, maturity and usage is substantiated [f7631, f7926]. These facts make similarity justification central to using historical evidence, and describe tool history as one contributor to confidence rather than sufficient assurance on its own [f7630, f14659, f7631, f7926].

relations.note: Glossary restates acceptance of service history for sufficiently similar systems with justified differences.
Both accept tool or service history as a confidence contributor subject to substantiated similarity.
